scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p desktop && bun run --cwd mobile typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build:api && bun test --timeout 15000 ./tests && bun scripts/test-cube.ts && sh scripts/rust.sh test --locked
scripts.build:catalog: bun scripts/build-cube-catalog.ts && bun scripts/build-niche-catalog.ts && bun scripts/build-case-images.ts && bun scripts/build-catalog.ts
scripts.dev:api: bun run build:api && bun run start
scripts.test:desktop: bun desktop/engine/build.ts && bun desktop/engine/smoke.ts && bun test ./desktop/tests
scripts.test:desktop:learning: bun desktop/build.ts && bun desktop/web.ts && bun desktop/testing/learning.ts
scripts.test:desktop:ui: bun desktop/build.ts && bun desktop/web.ts && bun desktop/testing/electron.ts
scripts.test:desktop:web: bun desktop/build.ts && bun desktop/web.ts && bun desktop/testing/web-app.ts
scripts.test:desktop:responsive: bun desktop/build.ts && bun desktop/web.ts && bun desktop/testing/responsive.ts
